content.title: FC Juarez vs Tigres UANL Live Stream: How to Watch Liga MX
content.text: Tigres UANL travels to FC Juarez hoping to build on its success in the CONCACAF Champions Cup as it targets a return to its winning ways in Liga MX on Sunday. Tigres UANL is just about hanging onto its playoff place status in the Liga MX Clausura ahead of Sunday’s visit to Juarez, who is similarly on the cusp of making a break into Mexico’s top eight if all goes to plan. Los Bravos are currently six points outside the quarterfinal qualifying spots, and due to the timing of the 2026 World Cup, only the top eight will advance to the postseason this term. UANL has kept back-to-back clean sheets in Liga MX, but takes on one of the more competent attacking teams in the division outside the current quarterfinalists. Tigres’ place in the CONCACAF Champions Cup was recently brought into question following a 3-0 loss against Major League Soccer’s FC Cincinnati during its first leg of its last-16 encounter. However, the Mexican giant then stamped its authority in a tie in the return leg, battering Pat Noonan’s side 5-1 to edge the double-header by a single goal. Guido Pizarro’s side can currently only dream of such fluidity in attack on the domestic front, having mustered a measly two goals across its last three outings in Liga MX. The most recent of those ended in a 0-0 draw against lowly Queretaro, exactly the kind of result that can come back to haunt a team when the margins are finest at the end of the season.
